description: Define one stable document-language contract for Yaya Loop projects before changing any localized behavior. The contract must separate current conversation language from durable project knowledge and preserve all machine protocol identifiers.
acceptance_criteria: The configuration contract defines document_language as a BCP 47 language tag
The documented scope lists which natural-language artifacts follow document_language and which protocol elements never change
Missing configuration language changes and mixed-language legacy content each have an explicit compatibility rule
The contract introduces no parallel localized workflow source trees
notes: Human review confirmed all acceptance criteria on 2026-08-26. The contract persists only document_language; conversation follows the user's current language. Canonical executable sources remain English and machine protocols remain stable. No localized workflow source trees or automatic project translation were introduced.
